findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_report" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Use when the user wants the full text of one published IndustryLens report (after finding its slug via list_reports). Fetch the full body of a published report …

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_reports, get_report, list_comparisons, get_competitor_moves_diff, get_pricing_changes, get_market_landscape · Private data: get_report · Public sink: get_report, subscribe_to_newsletter.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_reports, get_report, list_comparisons, get_competitor_moves_diff, get_pricing_changes, get_market_landscape · Private data: get_report · Public sink: get_report, subscribe_to_newsletter

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
